name: SP MCP Alpha ToolCatalog
bucket_source_of_truth: SharePoint MCP Alpha tool list Loop, 8/12/2026 revision
note: Bucket assignment is metadata for reporting and is NOT visible to the agent at runtime.

tools.name: getFileOrFolderMetadataByUrl
tools.description: Get metadata of a file or a folder (also referred to as DriveItems) from a sharing URL or a Vroom/Graph drive item API URL (e.g. .../_api/v2.0/drives/{driveId}/items/{itemId}). Only users with existing explicit permissions to access the file will be allowed to get the metadata of the file.

tools.name: get_document_images
tools.description: Retrieves embedded images from a single document. Requires one or more image signatures: call get_document_pages (or semantic_search) first and extract the image_<signature> tokens embedded in the returned snippet text. Returns image metadata and base64-encoded image data. Identify the document by spItemUrl (preferred) or by driveId + itemId.

tools.name: get_document_pages
tools.description: Retrieves the actual content of specific pages from a single document. Call get_table_of_contents or semantic_search first to identify which pages you need, then pass every 1-based page number via pageNumbers (for a contiguous range, list every page number in that range). Identify the document by spItemUrl (preferred) or by driveId + itemId.

tools.name: get_structured_text
tools.description: Extracts the text content of a single SharePoint document (Word, PDF, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.) as structured text. Best for files up to ~2 MB; for larger documents start with get_table_of_contents or semantic_search and pull only the pages you need. Output is a hybrid of markdown (headings, lists, tables) and structural tags (<slide_N>, <page_N>, <sheet_N>). Identify the document by spItemUrl (preferred) or by driveId + itemId.

tools.name: get_table_of_contents
tools.description: Generates a page-level outline for a single document. Use this first to understand what each page contains, then call get_document_pages for just those pages, or get_structured_text for the whole document. Large documents may take longer. Identify the document by spItemUrl (preferred) or by driveId + itemId.

tools.name: semantic_search
tools.description: Searches content by meaning or concept within one document per call. A good entry point for large documents (over ~2 MB) when you know what you are looking for but not where it is: matches come back with the page numbers to feed get_document_pages. Identify the document by spItemUrl (preferred) or by driveId + itemId.

tools.name: add_shortcut
tools.description: Creates shortcuts to one or more files or folders across one or more source-to-destination pairs. Supports shortcuts from multiple source libraries to multiple destination folders in a single call.

tools.name: apply_column_formatting
tools.description: Use for visual formatting of one SharePoint field: pills, icons, data bars, urgency cues, people chips, or styled links.

tools.name: apply_view_formatting
tools.description: Use for visual formatting across a SharePoint view: rows/cards, gallery/board layouts, group/footer summaries, row highlights, or calendar event styling.

tools.name: apply_wiki_instructions
tools.description: Returns SharePoint Wiki workflow and authoring instructions that should guide the current session. Invoke whenever the request mentions a wiki in any way, including read-only find, search, browse, and read operations.

tools.name: archive_items
tools.description: Archives one or more files or folders from a SharePoint document library by moving them to cold storage. Files and folders only — not generic list items. Read-only with respect to content — it only changes archive state. Does not unarchive, delete, move, or archive sites.

tools.name: check_permissions
tools.description: Checks whether specified recipients have access to one or more items in a SharePoint list or document library.

tools.name: configure_approvals
tools.description: Enable, disable, or configure SharePoint's built-in approvals for a list or document library. This is the default tool for standard approve/reject behavior, approval routing, and approval status tracking. Enabling approvals adds and uses `_ApprovalStatus` and can set default approvers.

tools.name: configure_quick_step_columns
tools.description: Called when creating, updating, or deleting a Quick Steps column in a SharePoint list or document library. Configures which quick steps appear in a Quick Steps column.

tools.name: copy_items
tools.description: Copy files or folders from one or more source libraries to one or more destination folders. Supports operations within the same document library, across different SharePoint sites, or to/from the user's OneDrive.

tools.name: create_approval_request
tools.description: Creates a new request in SharePoint's built-in approvals system for a list item or document, using the native approval experience instead of custom status-field updates.

tools.name: create_folder
tools.description: Creates one or more folders in a document library or SharePoint list, optionally at a specific path and (libraries / OneDrive only) with a color.

tools.name: create_form
tools.description: Creates ONE new SharePoint list form, or updates ONE existing form when its formId/formName is supplied. On update the existing form is preserved and ONLY the parameters you supply are changed. Optimize for beauty/delight, response-friendly labels/order, and exact reuse of existing fields without duplicate columns.

tools.name: create_list_items
tools.description: Creates one or more new items in a SharePoint list in a single call using an items array.

tools.name: create_lists_batch
tools.description: Creates multiple SharePoint lists or document libraries in a single batch operation.

tools.name: create_or_update_list
tools.description: Creates a new SharePoint list or document library, or updates an existing one (columns, views, settings).

tools.name: create_or_update_quick_step
tools.description: Creates a new quick step or updates an existing SharePoint quick step in a SharePoint list or document library.

tools.name: create_or_update_rule
tools.description: Creates or updates a SharePoint rule on a list or document library. STRICT GATE: only invoke when the user's request literally contains the word "rule". For every other automation phrasing — "notify me when…", "send me a message…", "alert me…", "automate X" — call a workflow creation tool instead. Do NOT paraphrase user intent into "rule".

tools.name: delete_field
tools.description: Permanently deletes one or more fields (columns) from a SharePoint list. All data in those fields is lost.

tools.name: delete_items
tools.description: Deletes one or more files or folders from a SharePoint document library by recycling them. Requires a single document library URL and relative paths for all items.

tools.name: delete_list
tools.description: Permanently deletes a SharePoint list or document library (moves to recycle bin).

tools.name: delete_list_item
tools.description: Deletes one or more items from a SharePoint list by item ID.

tools.name: delete_quickstep
tools.description: Deletes a specific quickstep (manual rule) from a SharePoint list or document library.

tools.name: delete_rule
tools.description: Deletes one or more rules from a list or document library.

tools.name: delete_view
tools.description: Permanently deletes one or more views from a SharePoint list. This operation cannot be undone.

tools.name: discover_sharepoint_lists
tools.description: Discovers all lists and document libraries in a SharePoint site. Returns list ID, title, description, template type, item count, server-relative URL, and author (creator) for each.

tools.name: download_file
tools.description: Downloads a file from a SharePoint or OneDrive document library and returns its content. Encoding is auto-selected by file extension: binary formats (.xlsx, .pdf, .png, …) return base64; text formats (.txt, .md, .json, …) return text. Check `contentType` on the response to decide how to decode.

tools.name: get_approval_enabled
tools.description: Checks whether SharePoint's built-in approvals are enabled on a list or document library before designing, configuring, or duplicating an approval process.

tools.name: get_approval_request
tools.description: Gets SharePoint built-in approval request details for a specific list item or document, including current state, approvers, and action history. Use this instead of custom Status fields for approval state.

tools.name: get_comments
tools.description: Get, list, or summarize the plain text file's comments. Not file content.

tools.name: get_content_types
tools.description: Retrieves site-level content types or site columns from a SharePoint site. Site columns are reusable column definitions defined at the site level (not list-specific columns). This is a read-only discovery tool for inspecting site-level schema metadata — it returns definitions, NOT content or search results.

tools.name: get_list_schema
tools.description: Retrieves the complete schema and metadata for a SharePoint list or library (SharePoint or OneDrive): settings, field definitions, item count, content types, and (on request) its views — the list of views and a single view's full definition (CAML query, displayed fields, sort/filter, row limit). Does NOT return item data.

tools.name: get_lookup_info
tools.description: Resolves lookup field values into the proper format for SharePoint Lookup fields. REQUIRED before create_list_items or update_list_items when any field is a Lookup type.

tools.name: get_onedrive_details
tools.description: Retrieves the current user's OneDrive site URL, document library URL, site/web/list identifiers, and storage quota information.

tools.name: get_onedrive_favorites
tools.description: Retrieves the current user's favorited items from OneDrive and SharePoint. Returns up to 500 items with a dataRef for full analysis.

tools.name: get_quicksteps
tools.description: Retrieves all quicksteps (manual actions) defined for a SharePoint list or document library.

tools.name: get_recent_items
tools.description: Retrieves the current user's recently accessed files and documents from OneDrive and SharePoint, sorted by last access time. Returns up to 500 items with a dataRef for full analysis.

tools.name: get_recycle_bin_contents
tools.description: Retrieves up to `rowLimit` items (files, folders, lists) currently in the recycle bin for a SharePoint web. Returns item IDs (GUIDs) needed for restore operations, with a dataRef for full analysis of large result sets.

tools.name: get_restoreable_lists
tools.description: Retrieves SharePoint lists and document libraries currently in the recycle bin that can be restored.

tools.name: get_rules
tools.description: Retrieves all automation rules defined for a SharePoint list.

tools.name: get_shared_items
tools.description: Retrieves files and documents that have been shared with the current user from OneDrive and SharePoint, sorted by the time they were most recently shared. Returns up to 500 items with a dataRef for full analysis.

tools.name: get_site_key
tools.description: Resolves a SharePoint site and returns an opaque siteKey required by every other tool and will return the site's onboarding context and available skills if they exist.

tools.name: get_taxonomy
tools.description: Single entry point for SharePoint taxonomy / managed metadata. operation="resolve" matches term labels and returns a write-safe formattedValue (REQUIRED before create_list_items/update_list_items on Taxonomy or TaxonomyFieldTypeMulti fields). operation="browse" explores the term-store hierarchy; browse ids are NOT write-safe.

tools.name: get_user_info
tools.description: Resolves person names or email addresses into the proper format for SharePoint User/UserMulti fields. REQUIRED before create_list_items or update_list_items when any field is a User type.

tools.name: get_view_definition
tools.description: Retrieves the complete definition of one or more SharePoint list views, including CAML query, displayed fields, sorting, filtering, row limits, and aggregations.

tools.name: get_views_of_list
tools.description: Retrieves all views defined for a SharePoint list or document library, including view IDs, titles, default status, and visibility.

tools.name: learn
tools.description: Get the full description, usage guidance, and parameter details for one or more tools. The tool list advertises only a brief summary and bare parameter names/types — call learn before using a tool whose slim listing isn't enough. Omit the argument to list all tools.

tools.name: list_item_versions
tools.description: Enumerates all versions of one or more SharePoint list items, including editor info, timestamps, sizes, and field-level changes. Use when itemId and listId are known.

tools.name: list_items
tools.description: Lists, counts, or filters items in a SharePoint list or library. Supports metadata filtering via CAML.

tools.name: move_items
tools.description: Move files or folders from one or more source libraries to one or more destination folders. Supports operations within the same document library, across different SharePoint sites, or to/from the user's OneDrive.

tools.name: rename_item
tools.description: Renames one or more files or folders in a SharePoint document library. Requires listFullUrl and parallel arrays of libraryRelativePaths and newNames.

tools.name: resolve_approval_request
tools.description: Approves, rejects, or cancels a SharePoint built-in approval request for a list item or document. Use this for native approval outcomes instead of custom Approval Status or Status field edits.

tools.name: restore_item_version
tools.description: Restores a previous version of a SharePoint list item or file as the current version. Restore creates a new version from old content (does NOT edit fields in place). Also use to undo changes when a user says "undo", "go back", or "revert".

tools.name: restore_list
tools.description: Restores one or more SharePoint lists or document libraries from the site recycle bin.

tools.name: restore_recycle_bin_items
tools.description: Restores items (files, folders) from the SharePoint web recycle bin to their original locations using their recycle bin item IDs.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Searches the current SharePoint site for documents and items matching a query via the SharePoint Search REST API (scoped to the site). Returns titles, paths, snippets, file types, server-relative URLs, and the listId + itemId needed to read a result with get_structured_text.

tools.name: set_folder_color
tools.description: Sets or changes the color of one or more existing folders in a SharePoint document library.

tools.name: share_file
tools.description: Shares a SharePoint file by creating a sharing link and sending an email notification to one or more specified recipients. Also handles requests phrased as "grant access", "give access", "give permissions to", or "let X edit/view this file". Accepts multiple recipients in a single call.

tools.name: unshare_file
tools.description: Removes a specific user's directly-granted access to a SharePoint file (direct ACL and specific-people sharing links). Does not affect group-based access or org/anyone links.

tools.name: update_list_items
tools.description: Updates one or more existing items in a SharePoint list in a single call using an items array. Each item specifies an ID, field names, and new values.

tools.name: update_onedrive_favorite
tools.description: Adds or removes one or more items from the current user's OneDrive favorites. Supports multiple items across different document libraries in a single call.

tools.name: upload_file
tools.description: Uploads a file to a SharePoint or OneDrive document-library folder. Bytes are passed inline via `content` — plain text, or base64 when `contentType="base64"`. The file extension determines the expected encoding.

tools.name: get_sharepoint_form_schema
tools.description: Gets the complete schema for a SharePoint list or document generation (DocGen) form using its sharing URL. The sharing link is resolved and redeemed server-side to grant access and identify the target web, list or folder, and form ID. Returns the form configuration and field schema required to understand which values can be submitted.

tools.name: submit_sharepoint_form
tools.description: Submits a SharePoint list or document generation (DocGen) form using only its sharing URL. The sharing link (a :f: folder or :l: list link, typically ending in a nav query parameter) is redeemed server-side to resolve the target web, list/folder, and form, so no site URL, list GUID, or form GUID is required. formValues must be a JSON array of field name/value pairs, for example '[{"FieldName":"Title","FieldValue":"Q3 Report"},{"FieldName":"Department","FieldValue":"Finance"}]'. Returns the submission result.
